fault_windows.label: Respot weld cell electrode wear, cycle time creep
Cockpit nutrunner calibration drift, inside spec
Primer sand deck understaffed, no sensors present
Transient fixture rattle that self corrects

alerts.headline: BS07 Respot weld cell is the constraint at 114 s. FA18 Roll out and audit runs dry in 4 min.
evidence: BS07 work content 113.5 s against standard 59 s and takt 73 s
sustained rate loss 17.3 bodies per hour for as long as this persists
buffers hide it for another 4 min, then the end of line counter starts to fall
23 stations downstream are affected in the 30 min forecast
alerts.action: Send a technician to BS07 Respot weld cell now. Cycle is 82 s against a standard of 59 s, so it is losing 23 s on every body. Check tooling and fixture clamp before touching the line speed.
alerts.expected_impact: Recovering BS07 to standard prevents FA18 from running dry in about 4 min and holds the shift plan.
alerts.falsifier: If FA18 loses less than two minutes to starvation over the next 14 min, this alert was wrong.

alerts.headline: FA04 Cockpit bolt torque is drifting inside spec. bolt_torque_nm centre moved -18.6 sigma. 141 bodies affected so far.
evidence: EWMA centre 39.42 against baseline 42.05, limit 38.00
CUSUM 382.9 sigma, condition held for 138 consecutive bodies
projected to reach the limit in 147 min at the current rate
normal detection lag from FA04 to FA16 is 13 min of line time
every individual reading is still inside specification
learned confidence 33% (offline calibration against 200 training shifts — informational, not a firing gate; see fit_calibration.py)
alerts.action: Recalibrate the tool at FA04 Cockpit bolt torque. bolt_torque_nm has moved from 42.05 to 40.91 while staying inside the limit of 38.00, and reaches that limit in about 172 min. Hold and re check the 13 bodies still on the line that passed this station during the drift.
alerts.expected_impact: Containment is 13 bodies on line plus 13 already rolled out, instead of an open ended recall.
alerts.falsifier: If the fallout rate for bodies built at FA04 after this alert is no worse than the shift baseline, this alert was wrong.
alerts.outcome_note: fallout 22.6% after the alert against 0.0% before, z=3.14

alerts.headline: PT06 Primer sand is slow. No sensors here, inferred work content 111 s against 73 s standard for the mix built.
evidence: inferred from hand off scans, method confidence 85%
no PLC and no process sensor at this station
upstream buffer state: WORK
alerts.action: Check manning and material at PT06 Primer sand. There is no sensor here, so this is inferred from hand off scans: work content looks like 109 s against a standard of 73 s. Confirm on the floor before acting.
alerts.expected_impact: Inference confidence is 85%. Confirming on the floor either clears the station or converts this into a manning decision within one cycle.
alerts.falsifier: If the floor confirms PT06 is running to standard, the inference was wrong and this station needs a scan point, not a technician.
alerts.outcome_note: true mean work content 107.9 s against 73 s standard
